mobile_and_low_power_guardrails.device_detection_contract: UrnViewer detects navigator.hardwareConcurrency <= 4, deviceMemory <= 4, or max-width 767px to activate low-power budget.
mobile_and_low_power_guardrails.data_saver_policy: When navigator.connection.saveData == true, 3D auto-load is disabled; 2D archival fallback displayed.
mobile_and_low_power_guardrails.unmount_cleanup_sla: SketchfabExhibit clears iframe.src to about:blank on modal unmount to force WebGL context garbage collection.
mobile_and_low_power_guardrails.fallback_scene_contract: When 3D model is missing or fails to load, UrnViewer renders FallbackScene (hotspot ring without fake urn mesh) or UrnAccessibleFallback (DOM/SVG).
